ai: After years of hard work, she finally made it as a singer.
經過多年努力，她終於成為成功的歌手。
Nobody thought the old car could make it up the hill.
沒人覺得那輛舊車開得上那座山坡。
We ran fast and barely made it onto the last train.
我們拚命跑，勉強趕上了最後一班火車。
If we leave now, we can still make it before the movie starts.
如果現在出發，我們還是趕得上電影開演前。
I'm sorry, but I can't make it to your party tonight.
很抱歉，我今晚無法出席你的派對。
Will you be able to make it to the meeting tomorrow?
你明天能來開會嗎？
"Thanks for driving me home." "My pleasure, it was on my way."
「謝謝你載我回家。」「不客氣，順路而已。」
It was my pleasure to help you move into your new apartment.
很榮幸能幫你搬進新公寓。
Off the record, the manager told me the plan might change.
私下說，經理告訴我這個計畫可能會改。
She spoke off the record, so the reporter could not use her words.
她是私下談話，所以記者不能引用她的話。
He was over the moon when he heard he got the job.
他聽到自己得到那份工作時樂翻了。
My parents were over the moon about the birth of their first grandchild.
我父母對第一個孫子的誕生開心極了。
As a rule of thumb, you should save a part of every paycheck.
一般的經驗法則是，每次薪水都該存下一部分。
A good rule of thumb is to boil pasta for about ten minutes.
煮義大利麵大約十分鐘是個不錯的經驗法則。
Just sit tight, and the doctor will see you soon.
先坐著等一下，醫生很快就會看你。
We decided to sit tight until the rain stopped.
我們決定先待著，等雨停再說。
After winning the contest, she seemed to walk on air all week.
贏得比賽後，她整個禮拜都飄飄然的。
I could walk on air after hearing such good news.
聽到這麼好的消息，我開心得像要飛起來。

you name it.zh: 不論什麼、凡是你能想到的
ai: They sell shoes, bags, hats, you name it.
他們賣鞋子、包包、帽子，你想得到的都有。
Whatever food you want, pizza, noodles, you name it, we have it.
你想吃什麼，披薩、麵條，隨便你說，我們都有。
The show offers a behind-the-scenes look at how movies are made.
這個節目帶觀眾看電影製作的幕後花絮。
Many behind-the-scenes workers make the concert run smoothly.
許多幕後工作人員讓演唱會順利進行。
Don't worry about the mistake; it's no big deal.
別擔心這個錯誤，沒什麼大不了。
Winning the school contest was a big deal for our small team.
贏得校內比賽對我們這個小團隊來說是件大事。
"I got a higher score than you." "Big deal, it was just one point."
「我分數比你高。」「那有什麼了不起，只差一分而已。」
He bragged about his new watch, but I just said, "Big deal."
他炫耀他的新手錶，但我只回了一句「有什麼了不起」。
The bottom line is that we need more time to finish.
重點是我們需要更多時間完成。
Whatever you decide, the bottom line is that safety comes first.
不管你怎麼決定，最重要的是安全第一。
Our bottom line is a fair price, and we will not accept less.
我們的底線是公平的價格，低於這個我們不接受。
For her, honesty is the bottom line in any friendship.
對她來說，誠實是任何友誼的底線。
The new rules will hurt the company's bottom line this year.
新規定會影響公司今年的盈虧。
Owners always watch the bottom line before hiring more staff.
老闆在多請人之前總是會先看盈虧。
By and large, the students enjoyed the school trip.
整體來說，學生們都很喜歡這次校外教學。
The weather here is by and large warm and dry.
這裡的天氣大致上溫暖乾燥。
Cut it out, you two! I'm trying to study.
你們兩個別鬧了！我在念書。
I told my little brother to cut it out when he kept tapping my desk.
弟弟一直敲我的桌子，我叫他住手。
Deep down, she knew he was telling the truth.
她心底知道他說的是實話。
He acts tough, but deep down he is quite shy.
他表面強悍，其實內心很害羞。
Deep down, the two plans are almost the same.
其實這兩個計畫幾乎一模一樣。
The problem is deep down about trust, not money.
這個問題本質上是信任問題，不是錢的問題。
"I'll pay for dinner, and you pay next time." "Fair enough."
「這次我請客，下次換你。」「好，公平。」
Fair enough, I understand why you don't want to go.
好吧，我理解你為什麼不想去。
She makes all her bread from scratch every weekend.
她每個週末都從頭開始自己做麵包。
After the fire, the family had to build their life from scratch.
火災後，這家人得從零開始重建生活。
Get real, you can't finish this project in one night.
醒醒吧，你不可能一個晚上就做完這個專案。
He wants to be rich without working, so I told him to get real.
他想不工作就變有錢，所以我叫他別傻了。

give or take.zh: 增減而無大變化、允許有小誤差
ai: The trip takes two hours, give or take ten minutes.
這趟路程約兩小時，上下差十分鐘左右。
There were about fifty guests, give or take a few.
大約有五十位客人，多少差幾個。
Our team will go all out to win the final game.
我們的隊伍會全力以赴贏得決賽。
She went all out to make her mother's birthday special.
她盡全力讓媽媽的生日很特別。
You passed the test? Good for you!
你通過考試了？真棒！
"I started running every morning." "Good for you, keep it up."
「我開始每天早上跑步。」「很棒，繼續保持。」
Eating vegetables is good for you.
吃蔬菜對你有好處。
Sleeping early is good for you, especially during exams.
早睡對你有益，尤其是考試期間。
The kids had a ball at the beach.
孩子們在海邊玩得非常開心。
We had a ball at the party and stayed until midnight.
我們在派對上玩得很盡興，待到半夜。
Have a heart and let him go home early today.
行行好，今天就讓他早點回家吧。
Please have a heart; I only need one more day to finish.
拜託行行好，我只需要再一天就能完成。
The budget issue became a hot potato nobody wanted to handle.
預算問題成了沒人想處理的燙手山芋。
Nobody wants to take the hot potato of explaining the delay.
沒有人想接下解釋延誤這個燙手山芋。
How come you didn't call me last night?
你昨晚怎麼沒打給我？
How come the shop is closed so early today?
這家店今天怎麼這麼早就關了？
We sat in the dark and watched the stars.
我們坐在黑暗中看星星。
The kids were afraid to walk home in the dark.
孩子們不敢在黑暗中走路回家。
The boss kept the staff in the dark about the new plan.
老闆對員工隱瞞新計畫。
I was in the dark about the surprise party.
我對驚喜派對一無所知。
Let me see, I think the meeting starts at three.
我想想，會議好像是三點開始。
Let me see what I can find in the fridge.
讓我看看冰箱裡有什麼。
Please don't make a scene in front of the guests.
請不要在客人面前大吵大鬧。
The customer made a scene when the waiter lost his order.
服務生弄丟點餐單，客人便當眾大吵大鬧。
Oh, my bad, I forgot to send you the file.
噢，是我不好，我忘了把檔案寄給你。
"You stepped on my foot!" "My bad, sorry."
「你踩到我的腳了！」「我的錯，抱歉。」
Can you help me carry these boxes? No problem.
你能幫我搬這些箱子嗎？沒問題。
If you need a ride tomorrow, it's no problem for me.
如果你明天要搭便車，對我來說沒問題。
"Thanks for the help." "No problem, anytime."
「謝謝你幫忙。」「不客氣，隨時都可以。」
I said thank you, and the waiter smiled and said, "No problem."
我道謝後，服務生微笑著說：「不客氣。」
This soup is not bad at all.
這碗湯還真不錯。
"How was your first day?" "Not bad, the people were nice."
「第一天怎麼樣？」「不錯，大家都很親切。」
She has been on the go since six this morning.
她從今天早上六點就忙個不停。
With three kids, my sister is always on the go.
我姊姊有三個孩子，總是忙個不停。
The waiter said the dessert was on the house.
服務生說這份甜點是店家招待。
Because we waited so long, the drinks were on the house.
因為我們等了很久，飲料由店家請客。
I have been out of touch with my old classmates for years.
我和老同學已經失聯好幾年了。
We lost each other and stayed out of touch after graduation.
畢業後我們失去彼此的消息，一直沒聯絡。
Some politicians seem out of touch with young people.
有些政治人物似乎和年輕人脫節了。
After a year abroad, he felt out of touch with the news.
出國一年後，他覺得自己和新聞脫節了。
Everyone was happy, so I didn't want to rock the boat.
大家都很開心，所以我不想興風作浪。
He never rocks the boat at work and just follows the rules.
他在工作上從不惹事，只是遵守規定。
The hikers returned safe and sound after two days.
登山客兩天後平安歸來。
Call me when you get home safe and sound.
你平安到家時打電話給我。
Everyone, say cheese, and look at the camera!
大家笑一個，看鏡頭！
The photographer asked us to say cheese before taking the picture.
攝影師拍照前要我們說「笑一個」。
So what if I'm late? The class hasn't started yet.
我遲到又怎樣？課還沒開始。
He said I was wrong, but so what? I like my idea.
他說我錯了，但那又怎樣？我喜歡我的點子。
Here's your coffee. There you go.
這是你的咖啡，拿去吧。
The clerk handed me the bag and said, "There you go."
店員把袋子遞給我說：「給你。」
You pressed the button and it works. There you go!
你按下按鈕就能用了，這就對了！
There you go, I told you the answer was simple.
你看吧，我就說答案很簡單。
There you go again, blaming everyone but yourself.
你又來了，什麼都怪別人，就是不怪自己。
There you go again, complaining about the food before you taste it.
你又來了，還沒吃就先抱怨食物。
Her email was short and to the point.
她的電子郵件簡短又切中重點。
Please keep your speech to the point so we can finish on time.
請讓你的演講簡潔扼要，我們才能準時結束。
It was touch and go for a while, but the patient recovered.
一度情況很危急，但病人康復了。
The game was touch and go until the last minute.
比賽直到最後一刻都勝負難料。
You know what? I think we should take a day off.
跟你說喔，我覺得我們該休一天假。
You know what, let's just order pizza tonight.
你知道嗎，我們今晚乾脆叫披薩吧。
The small shop only broke even in its first year.
這家小店第一年只是收支打平。
We need to sell fifty cups a day just to break even.
我們一天得賣五十杯才能不賠錢。

break the bank.zh: 花光所有的錢、耗盡資源
ai: A simple dinner out won't break the bank.
在外面簡單吃頓晚餐不會花太多錢。
She didn't want to break the bank on a wedding dress.
她不想為了一件婚紗花光積蓄。
The mobile game became the company's cash cow.
那款手機遊戲成了公司的搖錢樹。
Her small bakery turned into a real cash cow.
她的小麵包店成了名副其實的搖錢樹。
I bought this dirt cheap jacket at a night market.
我在夜市買了這件超便宜的外套。
The hotel was dirt cheap, but it was clean and quiet.
那間旅館非常便宜，但乾淨又安靜。
I got these used books dirt cheap.
我超便宜地買到這些二手書。
He sold his old bike dirt cheap before moving abroad.
他搬出國前把舊腳踏車賤價賣掉了。
My uncle offered to foot the bill for the whole dinner.
我叔叔提出要請整頓晚餐。
Who will foot the bill for fixing the broken window?
誰要負擔修理破窗戶的費用？
Let's go Dutch, since we both ordered a lot.
我們各付各的吧，我們兩個都點很多。
On our first date, we decided to go Dutch.
第一次約會時，我們決定各付各的。
The restaurant has been in the red for three months.
這家餐廳已經連續三個月虧損。
My bank account is in the red after the trip.
旅行過後，我的帳戶出現赤字。
The shop finally went back in the black this spring.
這家店今年春天終於轉虧為盈。
She works hard to stay in the black every month.
她努力工作，讓每個月的帳戶都維持有餘額。
He got the sack after being late too many times.
他因為遲到太多次而被解僱了。
Many workers feared they would get the sack this year.
許多員工擔心自己今年會被炒魷魚。
Anyone who breaks the rules might get the boot.
任何違反規定的人都可能被開除。
The coach got the boot after losing ten games in a row.
教練連輸十場比賽後被撤換了。
Starting a business here involves a lot of red tape.
在這裡創業要跑很多繁瑣的手續。
We lost two weeks cutting through the red tape.
我們花了兩個禮拜處理繁瑣的行政程序。

rat race.zh: 激烈的競爭、營營役役的生活
ai: He left the rat race and moved to a quiet village.
他離開了競爭激烈的生活，搬到安靜的村莊。
Many young workers feel stuck in the rat race.
許多年輕上班族覺得自己困在名利競逐的生活裡。
I'm a night owl, so I do my best work after midnight.
我是夜貓子，所以半夜過後工作效率最好。
My roommate is a night owl and sleeps until noon.
我室友是夜貓子，睡到中午才起床。
My father is an early bird and wakes up at five.
我爸爸是早起的人，五點就醒了。
The early bird gets the best seats at the concert.
早到的人能在演唱會搶到最好的座位。
He was the black sheep of the family because he quit school.
他因為輟學而成了家裡的害群之馬。
My uncle is the black sheep who never follows family traditions.
我叔叔是家裡的異類，從不遵守家族傳統。

dark horse.zh: 實力難測的競爭者、黑馬
ai: The new player was a dark horse in the tournament.
這位新球員是比賽中的黑馬。
Nobody expected her to win, but she was the dark horse.
沒人預期她會贏，但她就是那匹黑馬。
The teacher warned the class: no monkey business during the test.
老師警告全班：考試時不准胡鬧。
The police suspect some monkey business at the old warehouse.
警方懷疑那間舊倉庫有些不正當的勾當。
Even though she is famous, she is very down to earth.
雖然她很有名，但為人非常平易近人。
I like my new boss because he is down to earth.
我喜歡我的新老闆，因為他很務實又隨和。
She was on cloud nine after getting into her dream school.
她考上夢想的學校後開心得飄飄然。
I was on cloud nine on my wedding day.
我結婚那天開心得像在雲端。
The rules are cut and dried, so there is nothing to argue about.
規定很明確，沒什麼好爭論的。
This case is not cut and dried, so we need more time.
這個案子沒那麼簡單明確，我們需要更多時間。
We drove into a dead end and had to turn back.
我們開進一條死路，只好掉頭。
The little street ends in a dead end near the river.
那條小街在河邊成了死巷。
The talks reached a dead end after three hours.
談判進行三小時後陷入僵局。
He quit his dead end job to learn a new skill.
他辭掉了沒前途的工作去學新技能。
He is in hot water for losing the company's files.
他因為弄丟公司檔案而惹上麻煩。
The student got in hot water after skipping class again.
那名學生又翹課，惹上了麻煩。
After being late again, you are on thin ice with your manager.
你又遲到了，在經理面前已經如履薄冰。
She knew she was on thin ice when she questioned the boss.
她質疑老闆時，就知道自己處境危險。
Driving that fast in the rain is playing with fire.
雨天開那麼快簡直是玩火。
Don't play with fire by lying to your parents.
別玩火，不要對你的父母說謊。
When the price was so low, I began to smell a rat.
價格低成那樣，我開始覺得事有蹊蹺。
She smelled a rat when he refused to show his ID.
他不肯出示證件，她就覺得不太對勁。
Our team doesn't stand a chance against the champions.
我們的隊伍對上冠軍隊毫無勝算。
If you practice every day, you stand a chance of winning.
如果你每天練習，就有機會贏。
He wrote the review tongue in cheek, so don't take it seriously.
他是半開玩笑地寫這篇評論，所以別當真。
Her speech was funny and clearly tongue in cheek.
她的演講很有趣，顯然是開玩笑的。
The restaurant became popular through word of mouth.
這家餐廳靠口碑變得很受歡迎。
Most of her customers heard about the shop by word of mouth.
她大部分的客人都是聽人說才知道這家店。
It was raining, but we had a good time all the same.
雖然下雨，我們還是玩得很開心。
I know you're busy, but thank you all the same.
我知道你很忙，但還是謝謝你。
Tea or coffee, it's all the same to me.
茶或咖啡對我來說都一樣。
If you come early or late, it's all the same to us.
你早到或晚到，對我們都沒差。
Bubble tea was all the rage when I was in college.
我念大學時，珍珠奶茶風靡一時。
Short videos are all the rage among teenagers now.
短影片現在在青少年之間非常流行。
I'm not sure who called, but at any rate someone is waiting.
我不確定是誰打來的，但無論如何有人在等。
At any rate, we should leave before it gets dark.
無論如何，我們該在天黑前離開。
He looks serious, but he is a kind person at heart.
他看起來很嚴肅，但骨子裡是個善良的人。
She is still a country girl at heart.
她骨子裡仍是個鄉下女孩。
The host quickly made all the guests feel at ease.
主人很快就讓所有客人覺得自在。
He never felt at ease speaking in front of a crowd.
他在大家面前說話時從來都不自在。
He was often at odds with his brother about money.
他常為了錢和哥哥意見不合。
The new rule is at odds with our school's values.
這條新規定與我們學校的價值觀相牴觸。
At this rate, we will never finish before dinner.
照這樣下去，我們晚餐前絕對做不完。
At this rate, I will run out of money by June.
照這樣下去，我六月前就會把錢花光。
The manager does everything by the book.
這位經理凡事都照規矩來。
We checked the documents by the book to avoid mistakes.
我們照著規定檢查文件以避免錯誤。
Thank you for visiting, and please come again.
謝謝光臨，歡迎再來。
The owner smiled and told us to come again soon.
老闆微笑著要我們趕快再來。
Come again? I didn't hear you over the noise.
你說什麼？太吵了我沒聽到。
"The meeting is at eight." "Come again? Eight or eighteen?"
「會議八點開始。」「你說什麼？是八點還是十八點？」
Come what may, I will always support you.
不管發生什麼事，我都會支持你。
They promised to stay together come what may.
他們承諾無論如何都要在一起。
Come off it, you can't really believe that story.
別鬧了，你不可能真的相信那個故事。
Oh, come off it! Everyone knows you took the last cookie.
哎呀別裝了！大家都知道是你拿走最後一塊餅乾。
Your excuse doesn't cut ice with me.
你的藉口對我沒用。
Her fancy title didn't cut ice with the tough customers.
她那頭銜響亮的職稱嚇不了難纏的客人。
When the problems started, the manager decided to cut and run.
問題一出現，經理就決定落跑。
Don't cut and run just because the work gets hard.
別因為工作變難就臨陣脫逃。
He called in sick because of a bad cold.
他因為重感冒打電話請病假。
I'll have to call in sick tomorrow if my fever doesn't go down.
如果明天還不退燒，我就得打電話請病假。
The scientists broke new ground with their cancer research.
這些科學家的癌症研究開創了新局面。
Her first film broke new ground for women directors.
她的第一部電影為女導演開創了新局面。
Let's not argue over details and forget the big picture.
別為了細節爭論而忘了大局。
